New investments in transmission-connected electricity generation and storage are economically justified, financially efficient, and climate responsive

baseline.value: New transmission connected generation investments are not always economically justified, financially efficient, and climate responsive.

target.value: New transmission-connected generation and storage investments are: (a) consistent with NEPCO's Generation Master Plan, exclusive of fully grant-financed projects, which takes into account the target of at least 31% of renewable energy in the electricity supply mix by 2030, including transmission and distribution-connected generation; and (b) competitively procured consistent with the Public Procurement By-Law and PPP Legislation.

actual.value: This action is met for June 2024. No new transmission connected generation/storage projects were initiated for procurement by then.

baseline.value: NEPCO has been partially implementing the elements of newly-introduced corporate governance structure

target.value: (a) NEPCO continues to implement the adopted 3-year financing plan for its operations; (b) the Government as shareholder maintains the Board of NEPCO with strengthened composition, role, and responsibilities in accordance with the Charter of NEPCO; (c) the Risk and Audit Committee maintains its composition and role and continues implementing its responsibilities consistent with the Board of NEPCO Resolution No. 87, dated October 4, 2020; (d) the Strategy and Risk Management Function continues to be implemented in accordance with the Board of NEPCO Resolution No. 50, dated August 22, 2021; (e) the Board of NEPCO continues reviewing, approving and monitoring implementation of NEPCO's strategy, budget, and risk profile with defined financial and non-financial KPIs, and (f) align its accounting policies with IFRS in line with the conclusions of the gap analysis study that will completed in 2025.

actual.value: DLR #4.2: By June 30, 2024, (a) the GOJ as shareholder maintained the Board of NEPCO with strengthened composition, role, and responsibilities in accordance with the Charter of NEPCO; (b) the Risk and Audit Committee maintained its composition and role and continues implementing its responsibilities consistent with the Board of NEPCO Resolution No. 87, dated October 4, 2020; and (c) the Strategy and Risk Management Function continued to be implemented in accordance with the Board of NEPCO Resolution No. 50, dated August 22, 2021.
